name: Spark
primary:
A small spark that jumps between targets.
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 0.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 0.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
self_description:
